Known science foundations of Artificial Civilization Evolution Laboratory.

Sugarscape (Epstein & Axtell, 1996) grew artificial societies from simple rules. Agent-based models inform epidemiology and economics. AI Town and generative-agent demos simulate small societies. Scaling to civilizations with economies, technology, environment, and governance — validated — is unproven.

Key quantity check (Agents in largest generative demos / humans in a small civilization): computed ratio 0.001 against the reference value, relative error 0, within the stated tolerance of 0.5. This calculation was executed in Node.js at build time and the output stored verbatim.

Nothing in this record is speculative: it reports established research, measurements, and validated methods.

Physical and engineering constraints on Artificial Civilization Evolution Laboratory.
